proved_results.statement: For an original-coordinate product-bank form X^T(D+V Lambda V^T)X+2X^TMY+R(Y)+affine, with D original-diagonal, V orthonormal of rank r, fused physical volume Z_{r,k}=e_k(M^T(I-VV^T)M), canonical fused row marginals at most 1/2, and a=k+r/2>1, the density is at most [a/(pi(a-1))][(4pi)^(r/2)(2pi)^k e^(k/2)]^(1/a)|det Lambda|^(-1/(2a)) Z_{r,k}^(-1/(2a)).
For r=0,k=2 the bound is 4 sqrt(e) e_2(M^TM)^(-1/4) under row marginals at most 1/2; with max marginal h<1, q=max(1,2h), the bound is 4 sqrt(e/q)/(2-q) e_2(M^TM)^(-1/4).

For A=[[vv^T,sqrt(2)uw^T],[sqrt(2)wu^T,ww^T]] with u,v orthonormal and u_i^2+v_i^2<=1/2, spec_nonzero(A)={2,1,-1} and every independent cap-one input law has density at most 6e^(1/3)=8.3736745506... at all levels.

route_obstruction.statement: Three large eigenvalues plus positive fused volume do not force diffuse fused row marginals; the localized matrix [[1,0,0],[0,0,sqrt(2)],[0,sqrt(2),1]] has spectrum {2,1,-1} and fused row marginals equal to one.

next_step: Retain arbitrary same-bank curvature on the partner r38 recursive near-rank-two tube. Either find a low-rank Fresnel component whose transverse fused volume is diffuse, or route high-rank/heavy-marginal failure to mixed-hub, third-volume, physical-pair, or bounded-dimensional receivers without multiplying small self-curvature eigenvalues or rotating the product law.
